config.name: Doro articulated model V3
config.status: articulated concept model; not fabrication release or validated locomotion
config.coordinates: metres, radians internally; +x forward, +y left, +z up; intrinsic joints applied in tree order

simulation_assumptions.note: Torque bound, armature, damping, friction, link inertias and masses are placeholders. Serial output-axis actuation does not identify the physical coupled ankle transmission or real motor torque-speed/thermal response.

changes_from_v2: Explicit displaced yaw/roll/pitch hip frames and separate shoulder roll/pitch frames replace intersecting hip/shoulder axes.
Front links are 160+180mm. Outboard shoulder frame and a proposed +/-110 degree roll range support gesture exploration; clearance and real stop geometry remain to be engineered.
A complete 19-joint tree with visual envelopes, approximate collision primitives, allocated inertias, sites and abstract torque inputs is exported to MuJoCo and URDF.
Reference actuator cylinders show volume allocations, not completed mounts, belt drives or coupled ankle rods. The V2 ankle linkage is not silently transplanted into the new limb geometry.
Shoulders are forward of the torso by 140mm; positive elbow flexion uses the negative Y axis. Prescribed transition paws follow a world-space path to avoid leg and floor crossings.
